user_input: Where can I find my transactions?
model_output:
The location where you can find your transactions depends on the type of transactions you are looking for and the person or organization that you did them with. Here are a few common examples:
1. Bank transactions: You can typically find bank transactions on your bank's online banking platform or mobile app. You can also view your transactions by logging into your online banking account or by using your bank's mobile app.
2. Credit card transactions: If you made a purchase using a credit card, you can typically find the transaction on your credit card statement. You can also view your credit card transactions online by logging into your credit card account.
3. Online shopping transactions: If you made a purchase online, you can usually find the transaction on your bank or credit card statement. You can also view your online shopping transactions by logging into your account with the online retailer.
4. Utility bills: If you receive utility bills (such as electricity, gas, water), you can typically find the transactions on your bill. You can also view your utility bill transactions by logging into your account with the utility company.
5. Medical bills: If you received medical treatment, you can typically find the transactions on your medical bill. You can also view your medical bill transactions by logging into your account with the medical provider.
6. Rent or mortgage payments: If you paid rent or a mortgage, you can typically find the transactions on your bank statement or on your account with the landlord or mortgage lender.
